'''The Fingers''' was the name given to a [[mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] located between the [[Avesta Plantation]] and the [[Aboro Mesa]]. The top of the mesa was dotted by smaller mesas that resembled fingers reaching skyward, thus giving rise to the name of the mesa.<ref name="TOR" />
